parts.premise: In 2015, 1,100 parents were surveyed on the impact of homework on family life. Homework and family stress: with consideration of parents’ self confidence, educational level, and cultural backgroundPressman Et Al. (2015)Finds that inequality is directly increased as a result of assigning homework, with homework being a lead issue of separating those with resources and those without.View source → Fights over homework were 200% more likely in families where parents didn’t have a college degree.
parts.hypothesis: Some parents want the homework program.
